labels.name: aldehyde
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bearing exactly one H and one carbon substituent.

labels.name: ketone
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon with two carbon substituents and no H.

labels.name: ester
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to an O that bears no H and is bonded to a carbon.

labels.name: carboxylic_acid
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to an OH.

labels.name: amide
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to a trivalent nitrogen.

labels.name: primary_amine
labels.definition: Trivalent aliphatic nitrogen with exactly two H, not an amide, not imine/nitrile.

labels.name: nitrile
labels.definition: Carbon triple-bonded to a monovalent nitrogen.

labels.name: alcohol
labels.definition: Hydroxyl O bonded to an sp3 carbon.

labels.name: phenol
labels.definition: Hydroxyl O bonded directly to an aromatic carbon.

labels.name: alkyl_halide
labels.definition: Halogen bonded to an sp3 carbon.

labels.name: aryl_halide
labels.definition: Halogen bonded directly to an aromatic carbon.

labels.name: nitro
labels.definition: Nitro group in either the pentavalent or charge-separated depiction.

excluded.name: ether
excluded.definition: Divalent O bonded to two carbons. Subsumes esters and phenols structurally; kept because it is a named group the paper-style prompt would ask about.
excluded.why_disabled: Disabled at config level, not for lack of support (553 pool positives). Its SMARTS matches every ester and phenol, so a model scored on it would be credited twice for one structural feature and the label would carry no independent information. Kept in the candidate list so the decision is visible.

excluded.name: sulfonamide
excluded.definition: Sulfonyl sulfur bonded to a trivalent nitrogen.
excluded.why_disabled: Disabled at config level, not for lack of support (63 pool positives). Sulfonamide is the group the reference paper's own prompt set leans on; this project deliberately does not copy that group list wholesale, so it is held back as a candidate rather than adopted by default.
